name: CKEditor 5 - Dark Mode plugin
description: Adds a toolbar button to CKEditor 5 that toggles the editing area between light and dark theme.
project_description: This module is a plugin in addition to CKEditor 5, simply allowing to set up a Dark Mode button to switch the editing area between light theme and dark theme. It is useful alongside CKEditor 5 Font (Text Color / Background Color) or Font Size and Family when white text is available, making that text visible against a dark background instead of a white one. Some CSS is included to work around a few color issues with the Gin admin theme. After installing, add the Dark Mode button to your CKEditor 5 text formats at /admin/config/content/formats.
